original_text: \item Counterfactual Explanations \cite{arrieta2020explainable}: Counterfactual explanations provide insights into the model's decision-making process by identifying the minimal changes required in the input data to achieve a different prediction outcome.
injected_text: \item Counterfactual Explanations \cite{arrieta2020explainable}: Counterfactual explanations provide insights into the model's decision-making process by identifying the minimal changes required in the input data to achieve the same prediction outcome.
rationale: Swapping 'different' for 'same' reverses the cited definition of a counterfactual explanation, directly contradicting the mathematical mechanism detailed in Arrieta et al. (2020).
ground_truth_description: Reversed the outcome of counterfactual explanations from achieving a different prediction to achieving the same prediction.
